template.description: ClickHouse 列式 OLAP 巡检模板（单机/集群，基于 system.* 系统表）

chapters.description: 版本 / 集群拓扑 / 分片宏 / 库清单

queries.query_sql: SELECT version()
SELECT cluster, shard_num, replica_num, host_name, port, is_local FROM system.clusters ORDER BY cluster, shard_num, replica_num
SELECT macro, substitution FROM system.macros
SHOW DATABASES

chapters.description: 副本只读 / 延迟 / 未来 part / 队列深度

queries.query_sql: SELECT database, table, is_readonly, absolute_delay, future_parts, queue_size, inserts_in_queue, merges_in_queue, log_max_index, log_pointer, total_replicas, active_replicas FROM system.replicas

chapters.description: 磁盘水位 / 存储策略 / part 数量

queries.query_sql: SELECT name, path, free_space, total_space, if(total_space > 0, (total_space - free_space) * 100.0 / total_space, 0) AS used_pct FROM system.disks
SELECT policy_name, volume_name, disks, max_data_part_size, move_factor FROM system.storage_policies
SELECT database, table, count() AS part_count, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, sum(rows) AS total_rows FROM system.parts WHERE active GROUP BY database, table ORDER BY part_count DESC LIMIT 500

chapters.description: 后台合并压力 / mutations 卡住

queries.query_sql: SELECT database, table, elapsed, progress, num_parts, rows_read, rows_written, memory_usage FROM system.merges
SELECT database, table, mutation_id, command, create_time, parts_to_do, is_done, latest_failed_part, latest_fail_reason FROM system.mutations WHERE is_done = 0

chapters.description: 关键参数 / 运行时指标

queries.query_sql: SELECT name, value, changed FROM system.settings WHERE name IN ('max_memory_usage','max_server_memory_usage','max_concurrent_queries','background_pool_size','max_partitions_per_insert_block','max_insert_block_size','max_execution_time','max_rows_to_read','max_bytes_to_read','max_memory_usage_for_user')
SELECT metric, value FROM system.metrics

chapters.description: 异常 / 慢查询统计 / 大表

queries.query_sql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM system.query_log WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND type = 'Exception') AS exception_count, (SELECT count() FROM system.query_log WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND type = 'QueryFinish' AND query_duration_ms > 5000) AS slow_query_count
SELECT database, name, engine, total_rows, total_bytes FROM system.tables WHERE database NOT IN ('system') ORDER BY total_bytes DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

chapters.description: BACKUP/RESTORE 操作状态与失败原因（system.backups）

queries.query_sql: SELECT id, name, status, start_time, end_time, num_files, total_size, error FROM system.backups ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 50

chapters.description: 运行中的查询和未完成 mutation；ClickHouse 不暴露行级锁等待

queries.query_sql: SELECT query_id, user, elapsed, read_rows, read_bytes, memory_usage, is_cancelled, substring(query,1,500) AS query FROM system.processes WHERE query_id != '' ORDER BY elapsed DESC LIMIT 50
queries.query_description_zh: 运行中查询与资源占用

queries.query_sql: SELECT database, table, mutation_id, command, create_time, parts_to_do, is_done, latest_fail_reason FROM system.mutations WHERE is_done = 0 ORDER BY create_time LIMIT 50
queries.query_description_zh: 未完成的 mutation 与失败原因

chapters.description: 用户认证方式、登录来源与授权明细（system.users / system.grants）

queries.query_sql: SELECT name, storage, auth_type, host_ip, default_database FROM system.users ORDER BY name
queries.query_description_zh: 用户认证方式与允许登录来源

queries.query_sql: SELECT user_name, role_name, access_type, database, table, grant_option FROM system.grants ORDER BY user_name, access_type LIMIT 500

chapters.description: 最近 7 天查询异常与系统错误计数（system.query_log / system.errors）

queries.query_sql: SELECT event_time, query_id, user, exception_code, substring(exception,1,500) AS exception, substring(query,1,300) AS query FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'ExceptionWhileProcessing' AND event_date >= today() - 7 ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50
queries.query_description_en: Query exceptions in the last 7 days

queries.query_sql: SELECT name, code, value, last_error_time, substring(last_error_message,1,500) AS message FROM system.errors ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 50
queries.query_description_zh: 系统错误计数与最近错误信息
queries.query_description_en: System error counters and latest messages
